svg.text: FESTIVAL OF TRADITIONAL SPORTS · UNIVERSAL QR LIVE HUB · UI/UX SPECIFICATION
What every visitor sees the moment they scan the universal QR. It answers four questions in one screen: what
is on now, what is next, where it is, and where the full programme is.

g.text: Use Gate A or South Gate while the Parade
of Nations passes. Sessions run on time.

svg.text: Confirms the visitor has landed on the official event site.
The emblem ring uses the ten country colours.
Event name and edition, editable in Admin
Same header on every device and location
Shows which day of the event it is and the live local time, so
Clock ticks live; drives Live / Next statuses
Appears only when Admin publishes one. Used for gate closures,
weather, safety or major timing changes.
Hidden when there is no active announcement
Visitor can dismiss; stays pinned in Updates
The demonstration currently running, with a realistic LIVE
badge, venue, country, time slot, countdown and progress bar.
Background plays a muted clip or a photo of the sport.
Tap venue pill → Venue map with that FOP selected
Swipe row below for other live locations
Every other location live at the same time. Each card shows
The next sessions to start across all venues, with a relative
CHANGED badge when Admin edits a session
Five destinations, always reachable with one thumb: Live,
Schedule, Map, Explore, Updates. A badge counts unread
The QR never changes; only the content behind it does.
Mockup content is illustrative. Countries, sports, times and venues are managed in Admin and update live on the public site.
